title: Yggdrasil Event v1 (base)
description: Common structure of all events emitted by yggdrasil-core.

event_id.description: UUID v7 (time-ordered) uniquely identifying the event.

sequence.description: Global monotonic sequence assigned by the core PostgreSQL BIGSERIAL.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema. v1 is forever non-breaking.

aggregate_type.description: Type of the aggregate this event is about (manifest, product, workflow_run, etc.).

aggregate_id.description: Identifier of the aggregate within its type. Per-aggregate ordering is guaranteed.

actor.description: Who/what caused the event. Optional; null for system-emitted events.

emitted_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp assigned by the server at emit time.

payload.description: Event-specific payload; validated against the schema of this event type.
